goal: Finish the Survey and the whole Clear step (haul the debris, saw the fallen rafter, shovel the snow, sweep the floor, scrub the walls and the chimney) using only what the screen tells you; record the game time each checklist line completes. Say whether sawing keeps its progress when you let go of the button, whether the debris counter ever goes up, and whether you can see which parts of the floor and walls are still dirty.

findings.title: Scrub the walls is far slower than every other Clear task (13% -> 24% in ~70 s of continuous scrubbing)
findings.detail: With the scrub brush held against the log wall while sweeping the view across it, the walls line rose about 4% per 25 s of scrubbing (13% at tick 34455, 17% at 35363, 24% at 37966). Extrapolated, the walls alone need roughly 8-10 more minutes of holding the mouse, more than haul+snow+chimney together. Combined with the walls being hard to read (see below) it was the reason the Clear step could not be finished in a 35-minute session. Chimney, by comparison, went 0 -> 100% in ~1.5 min.
findings.repro: pt start --profile kindling --game-dir <kindling checkout> --seed 77; finish Survey; pt key 2; walk to any interior log wall until the meter shows '[---] 0% clean'; pt mousehold 25 while tapping arrow keys; watch 'Scrub the walls (N%)'

findings.title: Grimy vs clean log walls are nearly indistinguishable, especially from mid-afternoon on
findings.detail: Floor and chimney show progress clearly (swept boards turn lighter and lose their leaf speckle; scrubbed stones turn pale grey). The log walls look uniformly dark brown up close and from a step back, even with the lantern lit (~3:35 pm in game), so you cannot tell which logs are already clean. Only the per-spot centre meter ('Clean here. Move on.' / 'Grimy. Scrub it (2).') tells you, which forces sweeping the crosshair over every log.
findings.repro: after scrubbing a wall corner for ~25 s: pt hold s 1.0; pt shot X; pt key l; pt shot Y

findings.title: Sweep the floor stalls at ~93%: the last specks in corners are hard to find as the cabin darkens
findings.detail: Floor went 9% -> 89% in about 3 minutes of sweeping, then only 89 -> 93% over two more full passes (ticks 28600-30357). Remaining dirt is in corners, along walls and near the hearth; by 2:30 pm the interior is dim and the dirt speckle is hard to see. Nothing points to where the remaining percent is. The floor line was still not done when I stopped.
findings.repro: sweep the floor with pt key 1 and mousehold while stepping in rows; after ~89% look around with pt hold Up 0.35 and try to spot remaining dirt

findings.title: Fallen rafter needs an exact aim; the hit area does not line up with the drawn rafter
findings.detail: Standing next to the rafter the crosshair visibly overlapped it several times while the centre label still said 'Log wall'; it only switched to 'Fallen rafter' after ~2-degree nudges, at a point where the screenshot shows the crosshair slightly off the beam. Debris pick-up has a 12-degree assist, the rafter does not seem to.
findings.repro: after Survey, stand at about (0.8, 0.7) facing yaw ~285; pt look 15 0 repeatedly, reading the centre label each time

findings.title: Debris counter goes UP from 15 to 17 after sawing the rafter
findings.detail: 'Haul out the debris (15 left)' became '(17 left)' once the rafter was sawn into three lengths. A status line explains it ('Sawn into three lengths... three pieces to haul out instead of one'), so it is understandable, but a progress counter going backwards right after finishing a job feels like a setback and the message is easy to miss at low fps. Consider counting the rafter as 3 from the start.
findings.repro: pt key 4; aim at the fallen rafter; pt mousehold 10 (repeat until sawn); read checklist line 1

findings.title: Roof hole survey check needs the crosshair right on the open sky patch
findings.detail: Standing under the hole and looking up with the opening clearly on screen (off-centre by ~20 degrees), the label stayed 'Ceiling boards' and the checklist did not tick; it ticked only once the crosshair was on the blue gap.
findings.repro: after the other survey items: walk to about (0.8, 0.7), pt hold Up 1.2, look around the hole

verdict: Survey, hauling, sawing, snow and chimney all read well from the screen: sawing keeps its progress when you let go (6% -> 12% across a release), the floor and chimney visibly brighten where cleaned, and status lines explain everything including why the debris count rises from 15 to 17. The Clear step falls down on its last two lines: the walls scrub at ~4% per 25 s with almost no visible clean/grimy difference, and the floor's last 7% hides in dim corners, so the step could not be finished in 28 minutes of play.
